content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to send data from my [product_name] to AWS. I have followed available tutorials and examples, and successfully registered with AWS IoT. The device configuration is done, but I am having trouble making a webpage in AWS to display or work with the data. If anyone has a tutorial to share, it would be appreciated. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from topic: AWS IoT - Registration successful but item not visible in AWS.
Hi [user_name], How are you building your website? If you are using Wordpress, there are plenty of tutorials on YouTube. This video about hosting websites using AWS EC2 might be helpful.

Hello [user_name], Have you considered using [product_name] ([product_name]) to create your web pages? I worked on a similar project with AWS and chose [product_name] to set up the web interface instead of doing it in AWS.

analysis.insight_summary: The user has managed to connect their [product_name] to AWS IoT but is facing challenges specifically with building a webpage in AWS for visualizing or handling device data. Alternative solutions involving [company_name] software are mentioned, highlighting users’ hope for seamless integration between device-specific tools and major cloud platforms. There seems to be a lack of clear documentation or support for creating custom web interfaces in AWS for these types of devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks clear tutorials or instructions on setting up a custom webpage in AWS to display or integrate data from their [product_name], aiming for a simple workflow after successfully linking the device to AWS IoT.
